chitchat: swirls something amber and watches the deep water with mild appetite.
"Everything down there is inventory. It simply doesn't know it yet."
description: A platinum-tier shareholder in a suit that costs more than the building you were born in. He looks at the bay the way a cat looks at a fishbowl, and at you not at all. The building's staff call him Mr Brandt; he has never once asked what they are called.

bye.text: He has already stopped seeing you.

root.text: The shareholder does not lower his glass. "If you have to be up here, do try to be interesting. The last one wasn't." A pause, magnanimous. "Brandt. Sinclair Brandt. You won't need it, but people find it settles them."

clothing_layers: a shirt woven from something extinct
silk that has never met a working day

name: Sinclair Brandt
